support_rule: A distro/version is added to supported_platforms only after real fresh-host install, idempotent rerun, reboot recovery, exact release provenance, and normal public install-path E2E all pass.
implementation_rule: This public repository is the sole implementation authority for the GenOS MVP vertical slice. Do not maintain a parallel MVP implementation in the full-product repository.
ui_rule: Mockup-first. Do not implement material MVP UI surfaces until the Owner approves the visual contract.
truth_rule: No demo or fabricated current state. Unknown runtime facts remain UNKNOWN until directly observed.
